# Lingua.com

> > Lingua.com is an adaptive language learning platform offering vocabulary trainers and reading comprehension texts for learners of German, French, English, Italian, and Spanish.

The platform features spaced repetition vocabulary builders with progress tracking (Lingua Premium) and curated reading texts at A1-A2 beginner levels across multiple languages. Content is available in multiple interface languages to support learners worldwide.

## Vocabulary Trainers

- [German Vocabulary Builder: Master Words with Adaptive Learning and Progress Tracking](https://lingua.com/german): Adaptive German vocabulary trainer with spaced repetition and tracking
- [Entrenador de Vocabulario de Alemán – Aprende Palabras online y fácilmente](https://lingua.com/es/aleman): German vocabulary trainer with interactive learning (Spanish interface)
- [Italian vocabulary builder: Learn to use Italian words](https://lingua.com/italian/active): Active vocabulary trainer for Italian with translation practice
- [Vokabeltrainer Französisch: Wie groß ist dein Wortschatz?](https://lingua.com/de/franzoesisch/aktiv): French-German active vocabulary trainer with pronunciation practice

## Reading Collections

- [German Reading: German Texts for Beginners](https://lingua.com/german/reading): Collection of German reading texts for A1-A2 level learners

## French Reading Texts

- [C'est ma vie - Texto en francés](https://lingua.com/es/frances/lectura/vie): French reading text about Angélica Summer's life and move from Canada
- [Une journée de vacances - French Text for Beginners](https://lingua.com/french/reading/journee-de-vacances): French beginner text about Jean's vacation day with comprehension questions
- [Ma nouvelle maison - Französischer Text für Anfänger](https://lingua.com/de/franzoesisch/lesen/nouvelle-maison): French reading text about new house with vocabulary practice
- [Une journée de vacances - Französischer Text für Anfänger](https://lingua.com/de/franzoesisch/lesen/journee-de-vacances): French A1-level vacation story with comprehension questions

## English Reading Texts

- [My morning routine - Texte anglais](https://lingua.com/fr/anglais/lecture/morning-routine): English reading text about Bob's daily morning routine for beginners
- [Our Vacation - Testo in inglese](https://lingua.com/it/inglese/lettura/vacation): English reading text about Florida beach vacation for Italian learners
- [My morning routine - Testo in inglese](https://lingua.com/it/inglese/lettura/morning-routine): English beginner text about Bob's morning routine for Italian learners
- [My city - Testo in inglese](https://lingua.com/it/inglese/lettura/my-city): English reading text about city life in the United States

## German Reading Texts

- [Meine Stadt - Texte allemand](https://lingua.com/fr/allemand/lecture/meine-stadt): German text describing Frankfurt am Main city and culture
- [Ein verhexter Tag (Brief) - Texto en alemán](https://lingua.com/es/aleman/lectura/verhexter-tag): German letter text about Asmahan's challenging day and job interview

## Spanish & Italian Reading Texts

- [El día de la Hispanidad - Spanischer Text für Anfänger](https://lingua.com/de/spanisch/lesen/dia-de-la-hispanidad): Spanish beginner text about Hispanic Heritage Day cultural celebration
- [La lettera - Texto en italiano](https://lingua.com/es/italiano/lectura/lettera): Italian reading text featuring letter from Francesca to Emma
